_about: Icons for what can be at work on the player (StatusEffectDefinition, by id), for Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_item_icons.py --set conditions. Shown small beside the vitals: one bold shape and colour each.
chill: A cluster of pale icy-blue frost crystals, sharp and cold, with a white snowflake in the middle
poison: A single fat drop of glossy bright green venom dripping from a dark curved fang
roots: Thick gnarled brown roots coiled tightly into a knot, as if gripping an ankle
heartrot: A dark withered heart split open by creeping black roots, sickly yellow-green rot glowing in the cracks
Enthralled: A curling rose-pink ribbon of song with a small musical note, looping round like a leash that pulls, soft pink glow
Grit: A burst of flung brown dirt and grit, clods and specks flying outward from one point, earthy brown
Hamstrung: A deep crimson bite of jagged teeth marks across the back of a bent knee, dark red
Webbed: Thick off-white sticky spider web strands wound tightly round a leather boot, pale grey-white
eruption_roots: Thick dark roots bursting up out of cracked earth and coiling up and round, with a few broken splinters flying
